operator_io_quirks: Mixed-case table names quoted in DDL: "awards_coaches", "players_teams", "series_post"; unquoted tables lowercase. Identifier quoting must preserve original case.
teams has a backtick-quoted column `rank` (SQL reserved word) and commented-out columns (-- o_fga etc.) inside CREATE TABLE; line-based unique/check scan must not trip on comments.

teams PK is (year, tmID) but FKs from coaches/draft/players_teams/series_post reference teams(tmID) and teams(year) SEPARATELY (single-column FKs to a composite PK) -> parent column is non-unique; FK fill draws from parent values with replacement, so many-to-one is expected.
players_teams.playerID FK has parent_col=null -> same-name resolution to players.playerID (upstream dbinfo.py:87-88).
series_post has TWO FKs to teams (tmIDWinner, tmIDLoser) plus year twice; both child cols must draw from teams.tmID and teams.year independently.
awards_coaches.id and players_teams.id and series_post.id are INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT -> sqlite rowid alias; TS Number fuzzer will generate fresh ints, PK dedup keeps first.
players.birthDate/deathDate declared DATE but stored as TEXT 'YYYY-MM-DD'; deathDate has '0000-00-00' sentinel (not NULL) and null_rate 0.0.
players.height declared REAL, storage real (e.g. 82.0); weight INTEGER. Number fuzzer scale differs (REAL -> scale 0 default, int perturbation +-1).
players.firstseason/lastseason have only 2 distinct values (0, 1951) -> Number list-range quirk (min..max+1 then overwritten to full range) will produce wild ints.

awards_players.note, awards_coaches.note, players_teams.note, draft.suffixName, players.nameGiven/nameSuffix have null_rate ~1.0 or single distinct value -> String sampler with 5 original draws will mostly reproduce the one value.
teams has 1536 rows, players 5062, players_teams 23751, draft 8621 -> all well under 300000 cap; no rowid sampling needed.
draft.id INTEGER default 0 not null primary key (not autoincrement) -> TS Number fresh ints may collide with default; PK dedup handles.
operator_ts_expectations: String fuzzer for playerID/coachID/tmID/lgID/award/pos/name/college etc.: random a-zA-Z0-9() strings length 0-20 with 50% contaminate -> implausible IDs like 'aB3()x' that break joins/equality with literal pool values -> likely FN on queries filtering playerID='abdulka01'.

Number fuzzer for year/season_id/draftYear: full range [-10^0,10^0]=[-1,1] for INTEGER scale 0, then +-1/+-2 perturbation -> years become -1,0,1,2 instead of 1969.. -> FN on year BETWEEN 1990 AND 2000 style filters.

Date fuzzer for birthDate/deathDate: template from first parsable element (%Y-%m-%d), range from min/max of 5 sampled originals -> dates stay plausible-ish but '0000-00-00' sentinel in deathDate may parse oddly; leading-zero strip if no element starts with 0.

FK fill: coaches.tmID drawn from teams.tmID (161 distinct) with replacement, coaches.year from teams.year (75 distinct) INDEPENDENTLY -> (tmID,year) pairs mostly not in teams -> join coaches-teams on both cols yields few/no rows -> FN on multi-col FK joins.

Composite PK dedup (awards_players playerID,year,award; coaches coachID,year,tmID,stint) keeps first occurrence -> small tables shrink; child FK draws from FINAL filtered parent -> some children get NULL when parent empty.
String fuzzer on pos ('C','F','G','F/G','F/C') and conference ('East','West','Weset','Allstars','Denver') -> random strings break GROUP BY pos / WHERE conference='East' -> FN.
Number fuzzer on won/lost/games/points: full range [-1,1] for INTEGER -> wins/losses become -1,0,1 -> aggregates (SUM(won), AVG(points)) wildly off -> FN on HAVING/ORDER BY numeric thresholds.
teams.rank/confRank INTEGER: rank distinct 10 (1..10), confRank 0..15 -> Number fuzzer produces -1..1 -> ORDER BY rank / WHERE rank=1 misses.
players.height REAL: Number scale 0 (no args) -> range [-1,1] floats, perturb +-0.01 -> height ~0.5 instead of 82.0 -> FN on height > 80.
String fuzzer on award ('All-NBA First Team' etc.) -> random strings -> WHERE award='Finals MVP' returns nothing -> FN.

Null rate 0 columns (lgID, year, tmID) get NULLs from String/Number sampler only if p=1 (no elements) or checked; otherwise fresh values -> NOT NULL constraint failures at insert are skipped (writedb.py) -> rows_failed > 0, table shrinks.
